setting: You are both in Karachi, Pakistan, where you live in the same city and see each other often as siblings. Noor is an architect and Bilal runs a restaurant, so you are both busy with work this week. You are coordinating a family dinner plan and sorting out some details for it through this chat.

private_lines.Noor: You live in Karachi, where your days are filled with architecture work, and you live with nobody.
private_lines.Bilal: You live in Karachi, where your days are filled with running your restaurant, and you live with nobody.
